cues.zh: 七十金币，只是这趟罗马朝圣的出发价。路上还会花钱；而另一笔建立教首的费用，付钱的人也没有拿到教首头衔。这期就看这两笔投入：出发价之外还有哪些开支，建成的职位又归了谁。先看朝圣的实际账单，再回到出发前。
cues.en: Seventy gold was only the departure cost of this pilgrimage to Rome. There were further expenses along the way. In a separate case, the ruler who paid to establish a head of faith did not receive the title. We follow these two investments: what was spent beyond departure, and who received the office. First, the pilgrimage bill; then we return to the planning stage.
cues.visual_basis: Use source-bound P3/H2 stills as result illustration; no new footage or continuous-world claim.

cues.zh: 要提前判断谁会任职，得回到确认之前。先看头衔的授予顺序，再看建立者的资格和费用。
cues.en: To judge who will hold the office beforehand, go back to before confirmation. First, examine the title's order of recipients; then check the founder's eligibility and costs.
cues.visual_basis: Use existing source-bound decision preview or H2 still; label return to pre-confirmation analysis.

cues.zh: 这次出行和建制看过了，再补一个长期选择：圣地的类型。如果你还打算长期养兵或积累虔诚，殉道与奇迹提供了不同的奖励，也各有条件。
cues.en: After this journey and establishment, consider one longer-term choice: the type of holy site. For maintaining troops or accumulating Piety over time, Martyrdom and Miracles offer different rewards, each with its own conditions.
cues.visual_basis: Use existing source-bound type preview; no creation claimed.
